name: Temporal Equivalence Principle: Phase-Resolved Spatial Clock Priors for GNSS Outage Bridging
description: A phase-resolved TEP clock prior (fixed lambda = 4,200 km covariance plus a cross-spectral phase Gram) delivers deployment-ready GNSS timing holdover, clock-domain outage bridging, and degraded-geometry positioning gains on existing CORS/RTK infrastructure, validated on the live 68-station walk-forward observatory with cryptographically sealed ex-ante prediction.
